enforced_rules: Identity, canonical-resource, observation, and product-domain code cannot import provider adapters.
Forecasting feature code cannot import provider schemas, normalizers, validators, or raw storage.
Forecasting cannot import provider adapters or directly reference raw provider payload fields; StatsBomb corner payload decoding is owned by normalization.
The general experiment runner cannot import protected evaluation readers or direct database clients.
Production frontend TypeScript cannot import provider-native parser schemas.
Go and Rust serving/simulation source cannot add named model-fitting functions, known fitting-library dependencies, or prohibited model package directories.

Python worker classes and Go ticker schedules must be registered with the checker; registered production worker adapters must retain shared Work Orchestrator bindings and SQL adapters. The test-only generic provider worker cannot be constructed from production source.
